managenamespaces: Name of the special page shown in Special:SpecialPages.
action-managenamespaces: Action phrase used in a permission error.
namespacemanager-javascript-required: Fallback shown when JavaScript is unavailable.
namespacemanager-loading: Status shown while namespace definitions load.
namespacemanager-load-error: Error shown when namespace definitions cannot load.
namespacemanager-empty: Empty state when no custom namespaces exist.
namespacemanager-new-namespace: Temporary heading for an unnamed namespace block.
namespacemanager-add: Label for the button that adds a namespace block.
namespacemanager-remove: Label for a button that removes one namespace block.
namespacemanager-save: Label for the primary save button.
namespacemanager-saving: Primary button label while a save is in progress.
namespacemanager-save-error: Error message after definitions fail to save.
namespacemanager-id: Label for the numeric namespace ID field.
namespacemanager-id-help: Tooltip explaining the valid namespace ID range and talk namespace pairing.
namespacemanager-name: Label for the subject namespace name field.
namespacemanager-name-help: Tooltip explaining valid canonical subject namespace names.
namespacemanager-talkname: Label for the optional talk namespace name field.
namespacemanager-talkname-help: Help text explaining the generated talk name.
namespacemanager-help-label: Accessible name for a field help icon. $1 is the localized field label.
namespacemanager-required: Short indicator beside labels for required fields.
namespacemanager-optional: Short indicator beside labels for optional fields.
namespacemanager-content: Checkbox label for content namespace behavior.
namespacemanager-talksearchdefault: Checkbox label controlling talk default search.
namespacemanager-aliases-help: Tooltip explaining how to enter subject namespace aliases.
namespacemanager-chip-description: Accessible instructions for editable chip inputs.
namespacemanager-talkaliases-help: Tooltip explaining how to enter talk namespace aliases.
namespacemanager-editpermissions: Label for required subject edit rights.
namespacemanager-editpermissions-help: Tooltip explaining how subject namespace edit rights are enforced and entered.
namespacemanager-talkeditpermissions: Label for required talk edit rights.
namespacemanager-talkeditpermissions-hel: Tooltip explaining how talk namespace edit rights are enforced and entered.
namespacemanager-error-invalid-id: Validation error for an invalid namespace ID.
namespacemanager-error-invalid-name: Validation error for an invalid namespace name.
namespacemanager-error-duplicate-id: Validation error when an ID conflicts with another subject or talk namespace.
namespacemanager-error-duplicate-name: Validation error when a name or alias conflicts with another namespace.
namespacemanager-error-name-too-long: Validation error when a namespace name exceeds database storage limits.
namespacemanager-error-field: Generic validation error for a field.
namespacemanager-error-summary-item: Validation summary item. Parameters: $1 is the one-based namespace position, $2 is the field label, and $3 is the field error.
apierror-namespacemanager-missing-namesp: API error when a save omits its definition list.
apierror-namespacemanager-validation: API error for invalid namespace definitions.
